name: Civil Engineering Technology
description: Civil engineering technology programmes train the people who support civil design and construction — drafting and quantities, surveying, materials testing, inspection and the documentation a project runs on.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠ This is the smallest programme on the site: eight Florida public institutions and 16 credentials in 2023. Read that before planning on it. The work exists — 64,900 civil engineering technicians nationally, 5,500 openings a year — but Florida trains for it mostly through construction technology, drafting and surveying programmes rather than under this name, which is why this page's course list is drawn from those. ⚠ An associate degree here articulates into construction management and engineering technology bachelor's degrees at several colleges; ask before enrolling.

cips.note: Civil engineering technologies — eight Florida public institutions and 16 credentials in 2023. ⚠ The smallest footprint of any programme on this site, which is the central fact a student needs about it.

related.note: ⚠ The four-year degree, at nine institutions — more than award the technology programme. Where a technician degree is not available near you, this is worth comparing directly rather than assuming it is out of reach.
The umbrella series, and where the construction and drafting programmes that actually teach most of this work are filed.
A different industry using much of the same technician skill set — measurement, drawings, quality — and far more widely taught, if the construction sector is not the attraction.
